verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe add()/search() APIs, cross-session persistence ('sits between your application and your model', 'store facts once, then retrieve them by query'), and semantic search with reranking, and community reports (HN) confirm the memory layer solves a real problem in production/hackathon use. Some community commentary raises questions about relevancy scoring and hallucination risk, but these are general concerns, not concrete failures of the add/search/persist workflow. Missing for 10: independent long-horizon recall benchmarks and resolution of the community's hallucination/relevancy-metric concerns.
